decisions.reason: As a homepage-promoted extension of the core cloud messaging offer, it likely has strong strategic fit, scalable economics, and enough ongoing upside in a growing market to justify keeping the option open.
Its dedicated page and cited customer use indicate early market validation, and its fit with digital document workflows makes further exploitation more attractive than abandonment.

Even if it serves a transitional niche, it complements the firm's multichannel messaging base and probably costs little to maintain relative to its value for customers bridging email and fax processes.

As a close-to-core optimization feature for fax delivery, it likely has low incremental carrying cost and supports reliability for regulated customers, so dropping it would sacrifice useful option value.
Security is central to the firm's value proposition, and sandbox threat protection strengthens the email service stack in a way that preserves differentiation and future cross-selling potential.
